questions.stem: Let $X=\{x\in\mathbb{Z} : -4\le x\le 2\}$, so $X$ is a set of integers. The product $X\times X$ is drawn as points on a perpendicular graphical net. How many of the points of $X\times X$ lie on the axes (that is, have $x=0$ or $y=0$)?

canonical_solution.text_md: X has 7 elements: the integers from -4 to 2, including 0.
Points on the x-axis have y = 0 and any x in X: 7 points. Points on the y-axis have x = 0 and any y in X: 7 points.
The point (0, 0) is counted twice, so the total is 7 + 7 - 1 = 13.

canonical_solution.text_md: Each arrow goes from $a$ in X to $b$ in Y with $b = 3 \times a$.

questions.stem: $X=\{ 1, 5, 9 \}$ and $Y=\{ 2, 7, 10, 12 \}$. Which of the following relations from $X$ to $Y$ is a function?

canonical_solution.text_md: A relation from $X$ to $Y$ is a function when every element of $X$ has exactly one image in $Y$, so each of 1, 5 and 9 must appear as a first element exactly once.
$\{ (1, 10), (5, 10), (9, 12) \}$ has 1, 5, 9 each once as a first element, so it is a function.
$\{ (1, 10), (1, 12), (5, 10), (9, 12) \}$ is not a function: 1 has two images, 10 and 12.
$\{ (1, 10), (5, 10) \}$ is not a function: 9 has no image.
$\{ (1, 10), (5, 10), (5, 12), (9, 12) \}$ is not a function: 5 has two images, 10 and 12.
